properties.title: Finer resolution pays off in the Arctic
properties.message: Global models struggle at high latitudes, where resolution is coarse and data sparse. A regional domain at about 1/10 of a degree can improve the simulation markedly.

references.title: Expert interview 1: Coral Triangle & Benguela Upwelling

evidence.quote: moving to a higher-resolution domain—on the order of 1/10°—can significantly improve simulation quality.
